Pax Dollar transparency and attestation index

reserveReview.rationale: Exhibit B of the KPMG-examined USDP report at September 30, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time discloses USD $14,178,649 cash, $11,935,000 Treasury-collateralized reverse repos, no government money-market funds or direct Treasury obligations, and total redemption assets $26,113,649. Independently reproduced division by that disclosed total and rounding to two decimal places yields 54.30% cash and 45.70% repo. The complete repo maturity table contains one position purchased September 30 and maturing October 1; maturityDaysMax is therefore one day for this dated composition, not a standing investment-policy maximum. The report separately states that the repurchase agreements mature overnight. Repo collateral may not be sold or repledged. Asset categories and existing liquidity labels are unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of the USDP Redemption Assets Report, Exhibit B as of September 30, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time; USD amounts divided by disclosed USD total
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report identifies the complete asset-type composition. Individual commercial-bank and broker-dealer counterparties are anonymized, but no reserve asset class is unclassified.
